steps.expected: Return compact business facts, capability state, and cannot-do limits without claiming action authority.
Return intentId, approval package, approvedActionIntentHash, lifecycle refs, and required inputs if any.
Expose pending or ready lifecycle state without treating it as backend execution.
Execute only with intentId, approvedActionIntentHash, userConsent true, and accepted authority evidence when required.
Report the gateway result exactly and preserve receipt refs without upgrading request or handoff to confirmed.

assertions: A2A task progress is separate from business outcome.
userConsent appears only after exact approval.
state-changing execution carries intentId and approvedActionIntentHash.
ActionReceipt is gateway-produced and binds the backend result.

tamper.mutation: A2A caller sends action.execute directly to book_service without prior compile_action_intent.
A2A caller sets userConsent true from task text without rendering the approval package to the user.
A2A caller requests confirmed execution while authority assurance remains none.
A2A caller includes client-minted ActionReceipt fields in the task payload.
A2A caller acknowledges a result delivery before configured receipt or delivery trust verification.
